title: postMembers
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the JSON body `createRouter` reads; it calls `registerMember` and answers 201 with the member. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.

title: postTools
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the JSON body `createRouter` reads; it calls `addTool` and answers 201 with the tool's catalog entry from `catalogEntry`. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.

title: getTools
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it; it calls `listCatalog` and answers 200 with the catalog.

title: postLoans
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the JSON body `createRouter` reads; it calls `borrowTool` and answers 201 with the loan, its return flattened into `returnedAt`, `returnCondition` and `returnNote`. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.

title: postLoanReturn
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the loan ID from the path and the JSON body `createRouter` reads; it calls `returnTool` and answers 200 with the loan, its return flattened, and `late`. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.

title: postToolDamage
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the tool ID from the path and the JSON body `createRouter` reads; it calls `reportDamage` with the body's note and answers 200 with the tool's catalog entry. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`. The body limit is `readBody` with `MAX_BODY_BYTES` (64 KB) and `sendAndClose`, through which `createRouter` reads every endpoint's body: a declared length over the limit is refused before any byte is read, a chunked or endless body is read only up to the limit, and the 413 is written whole with `Connection: close` before the connection closes.

title: postToolRepair
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the tool ID from the path; it calls `markToolRepaired` and answers 200 with the tool's catalog entry. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.

title: getToolLoan
description: Its route in `ROUTES` calls it with the tool ID from the path; it calls `findLoan` with an `ActiveLoansReader` and answers 200 with the active loan. `createRouter` turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`.
